title: Dua lelaki ditahan bantu siasatan rampasan dadah di premis kurier
summary: RANTAU PANJANG - Pasukan Gerakan Am (PGA) menahan dua lelaki dalam serbuan berasingan di sini bagi membantu siasatan berhubung rampasan dadah di sebuah premis kurier pada Sabtu.Kedua-dua suspek masing-masing berusia 27 dan 30 tahun itu ditahan dalam Op Taring Wawasan pada Isnin dan awal pagi Selasa.

title_en: Two men arrested in drug seizure investigation at courier premises
summary_en: RANTAU PANJANG - General Operations Group (PGA) arrested two men in separate raids here to assist investigation into drug seizure at a courier premises on Saturday. Both suspects, respectively aged 27 and 30 years old were detained during Op Taring Wawasan on Monday and early Tuesday morning.
